name: Contrarian Pre-Earnings Drift Strategy
description:
A mean-reversion strategy that **fades the pre-earnings drift**:

- **Contrarian Logic**: If a stock rallied into earnings, bet it will reverse (short). If it sold off into earnings, bet on a bounce (long).
- **Entry Trigger**: On earnings announcement date, based on 10-day pre-earnings return direction
- **Holding Period**: 10 trading days post-earnings
- **Universe**: AAPL
source:
# Contrarian Pre-Earnings Drift Strategy
# Fade the pre-earnings drift: go opposite to the 10-day move before earnings
#
# RULES:
# - If stock rallied into earnings (10-day return > 0): Enter SHORT
# - If stock sold off into earnings (10-day return < 0): Enter LONG
# - Exit/cover position 10 trading days after earnings announcement
# - Position size: 10% of equity per trade

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Get earnings announcement data
earnings_data = earnings()()

# =============================================================================
# EARNINGS DETECTION
# =============================================================================

# Detect earnings announcement day using actual_eps (non-null means earnings reported)
had_earnings = is_valid(earnings_data.actual_eps)

# =============================================================================
# PRE-EARNINGS RETURN CALCULATION
# =============================================================================

# Calculate 10-day rate of change (return leading into earnings)
ten_day_return = roc(period=10)(close)

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY SIGNALS (CONTRARIAN)
# =============================================================================

# Long entry: Earnings day AND 10-day return was NEGATIVE (stock sold off)
# Contrarian bet: Expect a bounce after selling pressure
long_entry = had_earnings and (ten_day_return < 0)

# Short entry: Earnings day AND 10-day return was POSITIVE (stock rallied)
# Contrarian bet: Expect a pullback after pre-earnings run-up
short_entry = had_earnings and (ten_day_return > 0)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Zone executor with 10-day hold period for both directions
# hold_long=10 and hold_short=10 ensure automatic exit after 10 bars
zone = long_and_short_zone(hold_long=10, hold_short=10)(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Position sizing: 10% of equity per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=10)

# =============================================================================
# PNL TRACKING (for visualization)
# =============================================================================

# Track daily returns for PnL calculation
daily_return = returns(type=ReturnsType.simple)(close)

# Calculate returns when in position
# Zone signal: 1 = long, -1 = short, 0 = flat
# Multiply daily return by position direction to get strategy return
position_return = daily_return * zone.signal

# Cumulative PnL using compounding: Product of (1 + return) - 1
cum_pnl = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + position_return) - 1

# =============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# =============================================================================

# Cumulative Strategy PnL Chart
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Strategy PnL',
    category='Performance',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative PnL', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=cum_pnl)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark earnings events
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Earnings Event',
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='EPS', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='10-Day Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Filter', table_is_filter=true, table_visible=false)
        ]
    )
)(earnings_data.actual_eps, ten_day_return, had_earnings)

# Mark long entries (contrarian buy after selloff)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Long Entry',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Pre-Earnings Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Entry Price', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Filter', table_is_filter=true, table_visible=false)
        ]
    )
)(ten_day_return, close, long_entry)

# Mark short entries (contrarian sell after rally)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Short Entry',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Pre-Earnings Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Entry Price', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Filter', table_is_filter=true, table_visible=false)
        ]
    )
)(ten_day_return, close, short_entry)
